titulo.pt: auth-01: Pipeline de um request autenticado num painel (regra de acesso ao painel) (parte 1 de 2)
titulo.en: auth-01: Authenticated panel request pipeline (panel access rule) (part 1 of 2)

note.pt: o alias panel:{id} é o 1º middleware do painel: fixa e boota o painel corrente
note.en: panel:{id}, the 1st panel middleware, boots the current panel

note.pt: cookies, sessão, AuthenticateSession, CSRF, bindings e DispatchServingFilamentEvent declarados no provider de cada painel
note.en: cookies, session, AuthenticateSession, CSRF, bindings and DispatchServingFilamentEvent set in each panel's provider

note.pt: sem sessão → AuthenticationException com redirect para o login DO PAINEL
note.en: no session → AuthenticationException with redirect to the PANEL login

note.pt: false → 403 · [User] motivoDaNegativaDoPainel: conta excluída/inativa → pendente de aprovação → master_global abre tudo → papel do painel (roles.painel) · [User] painel sem tenancy (/admin, /infra) exige o papel no contexto global; painel com tenancy (/app) aceita papel em qualquer organização
note.en: false → 403 · [User] motivoDaNegativaDoPainel: deleted/inactive account → pending approval → master_global allows all → panel role (roles.painel) · [User] panel without tenancy (/admin, /infra) needs a role in the global context; panel with tenancy (/app) accepts a role in any organization

note.pt: a view de erro do kit mostra a negativa; o diagnóstico (conta, permissão ou papel ausente) só aparece em local/testing
note.en: the kit error view shows the denial; diagnostics (account, missing permission or role) appear only in local/testing

note.pt: (bind para a subclasse do kit): sessão travada ou ociosa → tela de bloqueio, guardando a página interceptada
note.en: (bound to kit subclass): locked or idle session → lock screen, saving the intercepted page

note.pt: com o tutorial desligado, rotas de onboarding respondem 404
note.en: with tutorial off, onboarding routes return 404

items.pt: kit.tenancy.enabled (KIT_TENANCY, padrão false): lido no boot do AppPanelProvider: /app ganha {tenant:slug}, IdentifyTenant e DefinirTenantDePermissoes; ligado por php artisan kit:tenancy
items.en: kit.tenancy.enabled (KIT_TENANCY, default false): read at AppPanelProvider boot: /app gets {tenant:slug}, IdentifyTenant and DefinirTenantDePermissoes; enabled by php artisan kit:tenancy

items.pt: lockscreen.enabled (LOCKSCREEN_ENABLED, padrão true): liga o plugin de bloqueio (rotas, item de menu e o middleware Locker) nos três painéis
items.en: lockscreen.enabled (LOCKSCREEN_ENABLED, default true): enables the lock plugin (routes, menu item and Locker middleware) in all three panels

items.pt: lockscreen.idle_timeout (LOCKSCREEN_IDLE_TIMEOUT, padrão 1800): segundos sem navegação (GET) até travar a sessão
items.en: lockscreen.idle_timeout (LOCKSCREEN_IDLE_TIMEOUT, default 1800): seconds with no navigation (GET) before session lock

items.pt: kit.onboarding.habilitado (KIT_ONBOARDING, padrão false): desligado, ExigeTutorialGuiadoLigado devolve 404 nas telas de onboarding
items.en: kit.onboarding.habilitado (KIT_ONBOARDING, default false): when off, ExigeTutorialGuiadoLigado returns 404 on onboarding screens

items.pt: kit.registro.verificar_email (KIT_REGISTRO_VERIFICAR_EMAIL, padrão false): ExigirEmailVerificado barra no /app quem não tem email_verified_at (decidido por request)
items.en: kit.registro.verificar_email (KIT_REGISTRO_VERIFICAR_EMAIL, default false): ExigirEmailVerificado blocks /app users with no email_verified_at (per request)

items.pt: no /app as rotas de Page/Resource passam a /app/{tenant:slug} e ganham IdentifyTenant + DefinirTenantDePermissoes (persistentes); surge GET /app → RedirectToTenantController; papéis passam a ser por team_id (permission.teams=true, gravado por kit:tenancy). /admin e /infra não mudam de rota, mas exigem papel no contexto global.
items.en: In /app, Page/Resource routes become /app/{tenant:slug} and get IdentifyTenant + DefinirTenantDePermissoes (persistent); adds GET /app → RedirectToTenantController; roles use team_id (permission.teams=true, set by kit:tenancy). /admin and /infra keep their routes, but need a role in the global context.
